title: Cheaters Using Bots in Wow. Is This A Real Thing?

posts.cooked:
When I tell people I play World of Warcraft. Some of them say that the game is full of cheaters using bots. From multi-boxers to gold sellers. I tell them that I have never seen
any of these cheaters at all. They laugh at me and tell me that’s because I don’t know what to look for and that I’m naive if I think Wow is free of cheaters.

So, my question is: Is Wow infested by bot cheaters or any other kind of cheaters? Or is that just a myth?
